[[File:Electrification icon.png|right]]
'''Electrification''' is an [[Arts Reaction]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

==Overview==
===Friendly===
[[Electrification]], when applied to enemies, is a debuff that increases {{G|DMG Type| Arts DMG Taken}}.

When an {{G|Electric Infliction}} is applied to an enemy with a ([[File:Heat Infliction icon.png|16x16px|link=]]/[[File:Cryo Infliction icon.png|16x16px|link=]]/[[File:Nature Infliction icon.png|16x16px|link=]]) Non-Electric Infliction, the Arts Infliction that was applied first is {{G|Debuff Consumption|consumed}} to trigger [[Electrification]].
* The debuff lasts for {{Color|12 – 30s (based on the Status Level)|1d}}.
* Deals an initial instance of {{Color|160% – 400% of ATK (based on the Status Level)|1d}} as {{Color|Electric DMG|6}}.
* Applies Arts DMG Taken {{Color|+12% – 24% (based on the Status Level)|1d}}.
{| class="wikitable wikitable-mobile"
|-
! {{G|Status Level}} !! Initial Electric DMG !! Increased Arts DMG Taken !! Duration
|-
| I || {{Color|160%|1d}} of ATK || Arts DMG Taken {{Color|+12%|1d}} || {{Color|12|1d}}s
|-
| II || {{Color|240%|1d}} of ATK || Arts DMG Taken {{Color|+16%|1d}} || {{Color|18|1d}}s
|-
| III || {{Color|320%|1d}} of ATK || Arts DMG Taken {{Color|+20%|1d}} || {{Color|24|1d}}s
|-
| IV || {{Color|400%|1d}} of ATK || Arts DMG Taken {{Color|+24%|1d}} || {{Color|30|1d}}s
|}
* Applying Electrification to a target with existing Electrification overrides the previous effect and resets the debuff's duration (unless otherwise specified).
* Some operator skills can also {{Tooltip/Forcibly apply|Arts|forcibly apply}} Electrification without requiring a different Arts Infliction to be {{G|Debuff Consumption|consumed}} (see [[Arts Reaction]] for more information).

===Hostile===
{{Quote|Certain enemy skills can apply stacks of Electric Infliction to operators. At 4 stacks, the operator becomes Electrified: Temporarily stunned and take more Arts DMG for a certain duration.|Tutorial}}
Some [[Enemies]] are capable of applying Electrification.
* The debuff lasts for about 10 seconds.
* Operators are stunned for 1 second upon receiving the debuff, preventing the Operator from taking any action.
* Operators take 20% more Arts Damage for the duration of the debuff.
* Operator also cannot receive any further Electric Inflictions. The Electrification effect is visualized by a darker yellow health bar and the Operator's model glows yellow.

Currently, only the [[YSTF Captain Blightshade]] in the Umbral Monument stage [[Arc of Shadow Flare]] is capable of applying Electric Inflictions and the resulting Electrification. The stage mechanics dispels all Inflictions from Operators after the enemy inflicts Electric Infliction for the fourth time, and therefore should make it impossible to reach the 4 stacks required for the Electrification, but through the use of Snowshine's Arts Infliction immunity it is sometimes possible to cause a desync, resulting in the hostile Electrification on Operators.

==Calculations==
===Initial Electric DMG hit===
{{Main|Damage calculation}}

===Increased Arts DMG Taken===

<math>{Final\,Electrification\,Arts\,DMG\,Taken} = {Electrification\,Arts\,DMG\,Taken}\times {Arts\,Intensity\,Multiplier}</math>
<math> \times Electrification\,Buff\,Effect</math>

Each point of [[Arts Intensity]] increases the effect by some percent, decreasing with more points of Arts Intensity up to a soft cap of {{Color|300%|1d}}.

<math>{Arts\,Intensity\,Multiplier} = \dfrac{3 \times Arts\,Intensity + 300}{Arts\,Intensity + 300}</math><br>
{| class="wikitable wikitable-mobile"
|-
! Arts Intensity !! Arts Intensity Multiplier
|-
| 0 || 100%
|-
| 100 || 150%
|-
| 200 || 180%
|-
| 300 || 200%
|-
| 400 || 214%
|-
| 500 || 225%
|}

Some operators have skills or talents that increase the effect of Electrification.

<math>{Electrification\,Buff\,Effect} = \left(1 +\sum {Electrification\,Buff\,Effect\,Bonus}\right) \times \prod {Electrification\,Buff\,Effect\,Multi}</math>

where <math>{Electrification\,Buff\,Effect\,Bonuses}</math> are all bonuses of the form 'Increase the effect of Electrification by {{Color|+x%|1d}}' 

and <math>{Electrification\,Buff\,Effect\,Multi}</math> are all bonuses of the form 'Increase the effect of Electrification by {{Color|x|1d}} times'.
